description: Describe how a rikma delivers what it sells: whether shipping is set up, the currency, handling days, the lowest free-delivery threshold, each zone (countries, districts, cities, postal prefixes) with its methods (fee, freeOver, minSubtotal, ETA days, dispatch days), the pickup points, and per-product rules (which products are pickup/digital only). Members only. For "how much is delivery of X to <city>?" use quoteShipping — it prices a real cart. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#getShippingConfigTool
name: getShippingConfigTool
